newsitem.title: JAPAN: Asahi Glass 97/98 operating profit seen up -- paper.
newsitem.headline: Asahi Glass 97/98 operating profit seen up -- paper.

text.p: Parent operating profit of Asahi Glass Co Ltd in the year to March 31, 1998, is expected to rise to a little over 2.5 billion yen, up 61 percent from its estimated operating profit for 1996/97, a Japanese business daily said on Tuesday.
Nihon Keizai Shimbun said the expected rise is due to strong sales of glass and construction materials as well as the company's successful cost-cutting efforts.
It said the glass maker is likely to pay a one yen commemorative dividend for 1997/98 as it celebrates its 90th anniversary in September, bringing its total dividend to 10 yen.
The paper expects Asahi Glass's parent operating profit to rise a year-on-year by seven percent to 15.5 billion yen, pressured by a rise in material costs.
Asahi Glass was not immediately available for comment on the report.
